source.stem:
Multiple choice questions.

System of equations

$$
\left\{ \begin{array}{l} 3 x + 4 y = 5, \\ - 7 x + 9 y = - \frac {5}{2} \end{array} \right.
$$

The solution is ( ).

(A) $\left\{ \begin{array}{l}x = 2,\\ y = -0.25 \end{array} \right.$

(B) $\left\{ \begin{array}{l}x = -5.5,\\ y = 4 \end{array} \right.$

(C) $\left\{ \begin{array}{l}x = 1,\\ y = 0.5 \end{array} \right.$

(D) $\left\{ \begin{array}{l}x = -1,\\ y = -0.5 \end{array} \right.$

hinge.title: Calculate the arithmetic mean as total divided by number of values and interpret it as the equal-share or balanced representative of the data.

mx.name: condition_omission
mx.teacher_note: arithmetic mean still holds here even though Every observed value in the dataset contributes to the sum before division is missing from the stem — on the item about Calculate the arithmetic mean as total divided by.

mx.name: relationship_reversal
mx.teacher_note: Sum of values is what produces arithmetic mean, so the usual direction of this relation is run backwards — on the item about Calculate the arithmetic mean as total divided by.

mx.name: scope_error
mx.teacher_note: The arithmetic mean rule also covers this: median calculation, so it is not an exception — on the item about Calculate the arithmetic mean as total divided by.

mx.name: operation_confusion
mx.teacher_note: Arithmetic mean is found by multiplying the given values instead of dividing, giving 22 as the reported result — on the item about Calculate the arithmetic mean as total divided by.

intelligence.enrichment: The arithmetic mean equals the sum of all values in the data divided by the number of values, and it can be understood as the fair-share amount each case would get if the total were shared equally.
